 2 909-ABA.738-22.odt  ORDER

(i) In the event of arrest of the applicant Aansiram S/o Savalaram Khandekar, in connection with Crime No.111 of 2022, registered with Police Station Satara, District Aurangabad for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 328 read with Section 34 of IPC and Section 59 of Food and Safety Standards Act, 2006, be released on interim bail on executing P.B. and S.B. of Rs.20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount.
(ii) Issue notice to the respondent, returnable on 04.07.2022.
(iii) Learned APP waives service of notice for the respondent-State.
